text:
ashley: quick follow-up from the postmortem — we saw repeated cross-region retries when UDP fragments hit our edge LBs, causing state drift.
liam: ack. I captured the pcap and the LB logs, looks like PMTU + DNS response truncation in some paths. sharing link: https://redwood.internal/pcaps/1768880000
priya: tl;dr — truncated DNS over UDP causes client retries that amplify across regions, then healthchecks start flapping.\nwe should treat it as a recurring pattern (seen 3x in 6 months).
sven: +1. immediate mitigations?\nashley: 1) short term: enable EDNS(0) size clamp on egress LBs for affected regions (canary to eu-west-1). owner: @liam. target: 48h.
2) midterm: add TCP fallback for large DNS responses in our resolver chain. owner: @priya. target: 2w.
3) observability: synthetic DNS probes with intentionally large responses to catch PMTU issues. owner: @sven + infra. target: 72h.
liam: started a canary patch branch: `lb/egress/edns-clamp`. command to apply to canary: `kubectl patch configmap lb-egress --patch '{"data":{"edns_clamp":"1232"}}'` — will roll to 2 nodes.
priya: created ticket INFRA-3421 for TCP fallback + config rollout, added acceptance criteria and rollback plan.
sven: I'll add synthetic probes to monitors: probe config snippet:\n```
- name: dns-large-response
  type: dns
  query: test-large.redwood-internal
  expect: NXDOMAIN
  payload_size: 2048
```
opsbot: deploy-bot: canary rollout initiated by liam at 2025-08-15T09:12:30Z. status: rolling(2/2)
liam: canary rolled, no crashloop. latency delta +1ms.\nobservability shows truncated responses reduced on canary nodes.
ashley: great. action owners, please add status updates here as you make progress. i'll consolidate and escalate if timelines slip. also adding periodic review: monthly incident trend check for DNS/PMTU.
priya: will do. next sync: 2025-08-18 16:00 UTC to review TCP fallback plan and telemetry.
sven: probe added to staging, PR: https://git.redwood/probes/1234 — will promote after 24h of stable runs.
liam: will open a follow-up postmortem note with the pcap links and canary screenshots.
ashley: thanks — tagging postmortem board and eng-oncall. :thumbsup:
priya: noting potential downstream: CDN edge configs may need adjustment. adding CDN team to INFRA-3421.
ashley: final owner list for tracking: liam (edns clamp canary) / priya (tcp fallback rollout) / sven (synthetic probes). deadlines in the ticket. closing thread updates once tasks complete.
